node.title: Payment-completeness hypothesis: the ledger taxonomy is EXHAUSTIVE
node.statement: The ledger taxonomy is exhaustive. NOT to be assumed or merely evidenced: it is the CLASSIFICATION OUTPUT of whichever enumeration route completes — the inverse class C_XR, the component list, the regularity-lemma exceptional sets, or the monodromy subgroup classification — each of which is complete by construction. Red-team results preview its content; they do not certify it.
node.attack_surface: complete step 2 (classification) of any one enumeration route; a new class member discovered there = the S9 protocol, built into the strategy rather than bolted on
node.falsifier: the red-team multi-scale resonance search (redteam_multiscale): any constructed super-poly alignment family outside the three ledger types. HISTORICAL BASE RATE: this class of assumption has already failed three times in this project (no-slack, one-scale entropy, raw fibers).

If unpaid: the fifth mechanism, found by pure thought; if absorbed/chargeable: a taxonomy completion at bookkeeping cost. | E25: the completeness hypothesis SURVIVED its sharpest test — the enlarged four-branch taxonomy absorbed the newly-discovered class with zero unpaid residue at toy scale. The historical pattern holds: taxonomy grows, completeness persists. | E35: taxonomy clause correction (projective multiplicative form X^e g(X^M)); no new mechanism — the example is a twisted pullback, inside the symmetry sector. Clause history: dihedral branch (X-2), projective twist X^e (E35), tail forms (X-4). Each found by counterexample, each inside the symmetry/quotient sector, fifth-shape watch STILL clean. | S9 FIRES — THE FIFTH MECHANISM IS REAL (first genuine one; six prior clean probes were structurally blind at weight > 4): primitive moment-trade blocks cancel without symmetry. Two independent same-hour discoveries of the same class in different object families is the strongest completeness evidence the program has ever had. | GATE FIX (expansion audit): the statement says 'whichever enumeration route completes' — set gate:any over the four alt routes.
